Do you enjoy working in a logistics environment and like having a variety of tasks?
For our client in Deurne, we are looking for motivated EPT Operators / Order Pickers.

After enjoying a cup of coffee or tea, you and your colleagues will start the workday. You will be responsible for a variety of tasks within the warehouse, including:

- Picking, checking, collecting, and preparing orders for shipment
- Wrapping and scanning pallets
- Moving goods and pallets using an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Lifting boxes weighing up to 23 kg
- Operating reach trucks, combi trucks, and forklifts

In addition, you may occasionally be assigned other warehouse-related tasks, such as applying stickers and labels, repacking products, inflating balls, and performing other general warehouse duties.

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 18,69 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear:: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery – delivery bag, helmet and phone holder
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040.

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, or e-bike,

- Valid forklift certificate

- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Full-time availability in a shift system

Are you looking for a new position as a warehouse employee in day shift? Then read on! We are looking for a motivated warehouse employee for Cordstrap in Oostrum. Cordstrap is an ambitious internationally operating production company in Oostrum (near Venray) that produces various solutions for securing transport loads. Full-time job for a longer period of time in day shift Salary of € 2.600,- gross per month Travel allowance Working in an international company that offers the opportunity to develop yourself Functieomschrijving As a warehouse employee you have an all-round warehouse function where you also perform work with the EPT. At AS Watson in Oosterhout, we are looking for new colleagues who are ready for a fresh logistics challenge. Are you searching for a varied role in a pleasant and motivating work environment, and are you willing to work in two shifts with allowances up to 150 percent? Then the AS Watson warehouse is the ideal place to continue your logistics career.

As an order picker, you ensure that orders for the Kruidvat stores are prepared accurately and on time. You work with a modern voice‑picking system that guides you through the warehouse. This system is available in three languages: Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with this system and your colleagues, you collect orders for stores in the south of the Netherlands and Belgium.

With your organizational skills, you stack the goods efficiently on the pallets. You can expect a wide range of products, such as soft drinks, toothpaste, toys, toilet paper, and cleaning supplies. Every day is different, and no two pallets are the same.

At AS Watson, you receive attractive allowances up to 150 percent and work within a clear two‑shift system. You will also become part of a friendly and motivated team.

- You take responsibility for your work and perform your tasks with accuracy.
- You are available to work in two shifts (06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00).
- You are flexible and can work full‑time or part‑time.
- You are available at least on Mondays, Tuesdays, and two Saturdays per month.
- You have your own means of transportation, such as a bicycle, e‑bike, scooter, or car.

As a Logistics Employee at GXO, working at the IKEA distribution center in Oosterhout, you will earn a starting salary of €17.27 gross per hour, with shift allowances increasing your hourly wage to up to €22.70.As a Logistics Employee, you are an essential part of the logistics process. You will work in Oosterhout, centrally located near Breda, Etten-Leur, Tilburg, Roosendaal and Dordrecht.Your responsibilities include packing, checking and preparing orders for shipment. You will use an EPT and handheld scanner to collect products, check their quality and make sure everything is packed safely and securely.You will work together with your team to ensure that orders are shipped on time. You will also keep your work area clean and help maintain a safe working environment.Every day is different. One day you may mainly be picking orders, while the next day you could be working at the packing station. - Night shift: Monday–Friday, 22:00–06:00
- Afternoon shift: Monday–Saturday, 14:00–22:00 (Saturday: 13:30–21:15)
- Morning shift: Monday–Saturday, 06:00–14:00 (Saturday: 06:00–13:30)

- Loading and unloading goods
- Re-stacking and processing incoming goods

Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find?

As a Purchasing Officer, you are responsible for sourcing all required parts for a single aircraft, from A to Z. This is not a role focused on routine purchasing or recurring orders. Your challenge is to track down critical aircraft parts when the source is unknown, supply is limited, or availability is extremely scarce. For you, "impossible" is not an option. If a manufacturer cannot deliver a part for several months, you proactively explore alternative solutions; for example, by creatively reallocating components from other aircraft undergoing maintenance.

You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of B1 Licensed Aircraft Engineers, B2 Avionics Engineers, and the Planning Department to ensure maintenance projects stay on schedule. In addition, you will meet with clients once or twice a week to provide updates on part availability and sourcing progress. This role requires persistence, creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to think beyond conventional procurement methods to keep aircraft flying.

- MBO+/associate degree level of thinking and working; eagerness to learn matters more than your diploma
- You're creative and proactive: you think in solutions, not limitations
- You speak fluent English (Dutch is not required; international team)
- You're client-facing and communicate easily with customers
- You stay calm and persuasive, even when the pressure is on
- Experience purchasing technical parts or raw materials is a plus

Ready for a new challenge in logistics? Become part of a world-class team at Valeo, the global leader in automotive parts. We’re looking for motivated full-time logistics professionals to join our dynamic facility in Helmond. If you speak English and have experience with order picking, this is your chance!

What are you going to do?
Join the team and help ensure smooth and accurate order processing!

- Order Picking: Use an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) and hand scanner to pick orders accurately and report discrepancies.
- Packing: Pack products with care, using the correct boxes and labels to ensure safe and timely delivery.
- Continuous Improvement: Contribute to projects that enhance safety, efficiency, and overall performance.

Your schedule:

Monday to Friday, two shifts:

- Morning: 06:00 – 14:00
- Afternoon: 14:00 – 22:00

Accommodation is not included.

What do we offer?
In addition to a gross hourly wage of €16,10 bruto per hour (with 7% shift allowance) that will be paid weekly, we offer:

- 25% overtime allowance and even 50% on Saturdays;
- Travel allowance will be € 0,23 per km (0-35 kilometer single trip);
- Quarterly bonus opportunities;
- 8.33% holiday allowance & 25 days of leave (full-time basis);
- Possibility of a permanent contract and skill development.

Where will you work?
﻿You will be working at Valeo, a manufacturer of car parts. Parts such as clutch plates, windshield wipers and ignition locks are transported throughout Europe from the location in Helmond. The company is easy to reach by car and is located in the lively Eindhoven region. Parking is free. There is a good atmosphere within the company and fun activities are often organized, such as an annual family day. During your break you can enjoy free coffee, tea or soup.

What do we ask?
- You speak and understand English;
- You have experience as an order picker using a hand scanner and EPT;
- You’re safety-conscious and ready to work in a fast-paced environment.

Are you interested?
